Java is rich in other beautiful images: one more,

the great Buddhist monument at Bordbodur. These
sculptures illustrate, not a complex mythology, but
the simple events of the 7a@¢akas and histories of the

ment, andsuave and full in form. These beautiful re-

with events of ordinary human life, and as such offer,
perhaps, an easier introduction to Oriental art than
themore learnedworks. No criticismcould be better
